mode: single-frequency L1/E1/B1 code DGNSS with VN-DGNSS RTCM corrections

source.title: Lane-Level Localization and Map Matching for Advanced Connected and Automated Vehicle (CAV) Applications
source.location: Appendix B, section 4, Table 1 (PDF page 57 in the 66-page USDOT copy)
source.conditions: moving vehicle near UCR with a clear view of the sky; M8P fixed RTK reference

implementation_scope.mean: zero; published finite-experiment means are recorded but not applied
implementation_scope.white_sigma_rounding: north 0.00 is the published rounded value, not proof of physically zero white noise
implementation_scope.sample_rate: native Gazebo cadence and delay retained; correlation time re-discretized at actual sample intervals; white sigma kept per sample, not a noise density
implementation_scope.velocity: ideal native velocity; no velocity-error calibration is provided by this position-only reference
implementation_scope.environment_model: disabled; no calibrated sky-obstruction law supplied by the reference
implementation_scope.limits: position-domain statistical reproduction; not raw GNSS/RTCM processing, vendor hardware emulation, RTK fixed performance, or an urban-canyon calibration
